footer.about: Short lessons and practice to help you use artificial intelligence confidently and responsibly at school, at work and in everyday life.
fav.label: Bookmark: {name}
home.title: Learn to work with AI step by step
home.lead: Short lessons, example prompts and practice for study, work and everyday tasks. We explain in plain language how to ask questions and check the answers.
home.demo.label: Lesson example: improving a prompt
home.demo.good: Give me <mark>5 points for a 2-minute talk</mark> for <mark>8th graders</mark>: why sleep matters for memory. <mark>Plain words</mark>, one example.
home.demo.checkText: Compare facts with a textbook and ask the AI to flag what it isn't sure about.
home.personal.continue: You stopped halfway through. Pick up where you left off.
home.personal.plan: The next lesson in your learning plan.
home.personal.next: A good lesson you haven't taken yet.
home.personal.allDone: You've completed all lessons! Reinforce what you learned in practice.
home.dir.title: What do you want to do with AI?
home.pop.title: Where most people start
home.how.title: Learn at your own pace
home.how.1.title: A short lesson
home.how.1.text: Each lesson takes 6–10 minutes: a goal, an explanation, a step-by-step example and a summary. No extra theory.
home.how.2.title: Practice
home.how.2.text: Copy an example prompt, adapt it to your task and complete an exercise with hints.
home.how.3.title: Come back any time
home.how.3.text: Progress, bookmarks and history are saved in your account. Return to a lesson at the same step.
home.tools.title: Tools for different tasks
home.safe.title: AI assists, you decide
home.safe.text: Every lesson reminds you how to protect personal data, check facts and follow school and workplace rules.
home.safe.1: Don't type passwords, addresses, phone numbers or ID details into chatbots
home.safe.2: Check important facts against reliable sources
home.safe.3: Respect copyright and the rules of your school or workplace
home.safe.4: Don't present generated work as your own
catalog.title: AI tools
catalog.lead: What each tool is good for, how hard it is, and a prompt to start with.
catalog.disclaimer: Descriptions updated on {date}. We don't list prices or plans: they change often, as do features and availability in your country. Check the official website before you use a tool.
lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.lead: Every lesson has a goal, a short explanation, a step-by-step example, a task and a summary.
lessons.guest: Lessons are open without an account, but progress isn't saved unless you sign in.
lesson.verifyReminder: Remember: AI can be wrong. Check important facts and don't share personal data.
lesson.guest: You're reading without signing in: the whole lesson is open, but your step and completion won't be saved.
lesson.loginToSave: Sign in to mark the lesson as completed.
practice.title: Exercises
practice.lead: Short exercises with hints. Mistakes are fine: that's what practice is for.
practice.privateNote: This text stays in your browser. We don't save it or send it anywhere.
practice.guest: Exercises are open to everyone. Without an account answers are checked, but completion isn't saved.
practice.loginToSave: Sign in to save your completed exercise.
builder.title: Prompt builder
builder.lead: Pick a task, context, style and format. The site assembles a prompt you can copy and edit.
builder.contextPlaceholder: For example: it's for a 3-minute talk
builder.contextHint: Don't include names, addresses, phone numbers or other personal data.
builder.opt.uncertain: Flag anything the AI is unsure about
builder.opt.sources: Suggest where to check the facts
builder.edited: You edited the prompt by hand. Press “Reset” to rebuild it.
builder.privacy: The builder runs in your browser. We don't send your prompt to any AI service: copy it and paste it wherever you like.
builder.piiWarning: It looks like you entered an email address or phone number. Replace it with [email] or [phone] before sending the prompt to an AI.
builder.tpl.edit: Edit my text ({topic}): fix mistakes and make it clearer while keeping my style.
builder.tpl.image: Write a detailed description for an image generator: {topic}. Include the subject, setting, style, composition and lighting.
builder.tpl.code: Help me with this programming task: {topic}. Explain the solution step by step.
builder.tpl.tone.simple: Use simple words, as if for a beginner.
builder.tpl.tone.friendly: Be friendly and use lively examples.
builder.tpl.tone.creative: Be creative and suggest unexpected options.
builder.tpl.format.list: Format the answer as a bulleted list.
builder.tpl.format.steps: Format the answer as numbered steps.
builder.tpl.format.table: Format the answer as a table.
builder.tpl.format.text: Format the answer as connected paragraphs.
builder.tpl.opt.clarify: Before answering, ask me up to three clarifying questions.
builder.tpl.opt.uncertain: If you're unsure about anything, say so clearly.
builder.tpl.opt.sources: At the end, suggest where I can check the key facts.
builder.tpl.opt.noJargon: Avoid jargon; if a term is necessary, explain it.
quiz.title: Let's find your learning path
quiz.lead: Three questions, under a minute. Based on your answers, we'll suggest lessons and a comfortable pace.
quiz.question: Question {n} of {total}
quiz.savedToProfile: The plan is saved in your dashboard. You can change it any time by retaking the quiz.
quiz.guestSave: The plan is saved in this browser only. Sign up and it moves to your account, and then lesson progress is saved too.
quiz.hasPlan: You already have a learning plan. Retaking the quiz will replace it.
account.reminder: It's been a while. That's fine! When it suits you, continue the lesson “{lesson}”.
account.noPlan: Answer three questions and we'll suggest lessons that fit your goals.
